SUMMARY: FruitFactoryPineapple procedurally builds a pineapple: a bumpy circular-cross-section fruit body covered in tiled "cells" (with tiny leaf needles) plus a spiky leaf crown on top. The upper-level files form a modular fruit pipeline — pineapple.py samples all parameters (cross-section, body shape, surface material/cells, stem/crown) and feeds them to general_fruit.py, which assembles cross_section_lib (2D profile), fruit_utils (shared geonode helpers), stem_lib (crown/leaves + shaders), and surfaces/pineapple_surface.py (cell body + colors) into one mesh. To hit the "glowing blue mushroom cluster" request you'd swap colors toward cyan/blue, add emission in the shaders, reshape the body to a domed cap, thin the stem, and instance several at varied heights.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/pineapple.py
  FruitFactoryPineapple.__init__: sets name="pineapple", takes scale(1.0) and factory_seed.
    knobs: scale(1.0) -> overall size multiplier
  sample_cross_section_params: defines the 2D body outline (circle).
    knobs: cross_section_name("circle_cross_section"; swap to star/coconut) -> silhouette shape; "radius"(normal(1.2,0.05) random) -> body fatness; "random seed"(uniform(-100,100) random) -> noise offset; Resolution(from surface_resolution=64) -> smoothness
  sample_shape_params: body vertical profile / silhouette via radius_control_points on a quadratic curve.
    knobs: radius_control_points(6 pts, one x=uniform(0.3,0.7) random) -> body bulge/taper (edit to a domed cap for mushroom); "Start"(uniform jitter x,y,z=-0.8..-1.2 random) -> bottom position; "End"((0,0,1.0)) -> top; "noise scale pos"(0.5)/"noise amount pos"(0.4) -> body waviness
  sample_surface_params: cell colors (HSV, jittered) + cell tiling density.
    knobs: bottom_color(HSV 0.192,0.898,0.095 ±noise) -> greenish base; mid_color(0.05,0.96,0.55) -> orange mid; top_color(0.04,0.99,0.45) -> orange-red top; center_color(0.07,0.63,0.84) -> pale center — RECOLOR ALL toward hue ~0.55 (cyan) for blue mushroom; cell_distance(uniform(0.18,0.22) random) -> cell/scale size; scale_multiplier(1.8) -> extra size; surface_resolution(64) -> mesh detail
  sample_stem_params: pineapple leaf crown.
    knobs: leaf_color(HSV 0.32,0.79,0.20 ±noise) -> leaf green; "number of leaves"(randint(40,80) random) -> crown density; "scale base"(normal(0.5,0.05)), "scale z base"(normal(0.15,0.03)), "scale z top"(normal(0.62,0.03)) -> leaf sizes; "rot z base"(normal(-0.62,0.03)), "rot z top"(normal(0.54,0.03)), "rotation base"(-uniform(0.5,0.55)) -> leaf angles; "noise amount"(0.1)/"noise scale"(uniform(10,30)) -> crown irregularity. (For mushrooms: replace with empty_stem or thin cap.)

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/surfaces/pineapple_surface.py
  nodegroup_pineapple_surface: builds cell bodies + needle leaves, scatters them on the body, joins with a plain-colored base.
    knobs: color defaults color_bottom/mid/top/center (overridden by factory) -> cell gradient; point distance(0.22)/cell scale(0.2) -> tiling; rot std(0.3) in random_rotation_scale -> cell tilt; Displacement(0.2)/Scale(10.0) in surface bump -> bump roughness; needle leaf Middle/End/Scale(0.3), Rotation(-1.0315) -> spike look; "parameter max"(0.999)/"noise amount"(0.05) -> coverage
  shader_cell: cell surface material (4-stop ColorRamp gradient by "radius").
    knobs: colorramp stops(0.0/0.67/0.93/1.0) -> gradient bands; Hue(0.55) fixed; Roughness(0.2) -> shininess. (Add Emission here for glow.)
  shader_needle: needle/leaf color mix (MixRGB of color1,color2), noise Scale(8.0).
    knobs: noise Scale(8.0) -> pattern; colors from factory -> needle tint
  nodegroup_pineapple_cell_body: individual cell mesh (bezier profile + circle cross-section).
    knobs: float_curve pts [(0,1),(0.157,0.875),(0.804,0.531),(1,0)] -> cell shape (dome the top for cap look); circle cross-section noise scale(8.0)/amount(0.4)/Resolution(64) -> cell bumpiness; scale diff(-0.3) -> asymmetry

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/stem_lib.py
  nodegroup_pineapple_stem / nodegroup_pineapple_crown / nodegroup_pineapple_leaf: the leaf-crown assembly (spiral placement of curved leaves).
    knobs: crown spiral Rotations(5.0), Start/End Radius(0.01) -> crown spread; leaf radius float_curve [(0,1),(0.68,0.506),(1,0)] -> leaf taper; leaf profile Transform Scale(0.5,0.1,1.0) -> leaf cross-section; RandomValue(-0.1..0.1 random) -> per-leaf jitter
  shader_leaf: leaf material; PrincipledBSDF Roughness(1.0), Specular(0.5955); noise Scale(3.48).
  nodegroup_basic_stem / shader_basic_stem_shader: generic stem tube + green noise shader (use for a mushroom stem: thin cross_radius, pale color, add emission).
    knobs: cross_radius(0.08), Scale(1,1,2), surface bump Displacement(0.01)/Scale(2.9,20)
  nodegroup_empty_stem: emits no geometry (use to remove crown).
  nodegroup_calyx_stem / nodegroup_coconut_stem / shaders: alternate stems (unused by pineapple).

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/cross_section_lib.py
  nodegroup_circle_cross_section (used): round profile.
    knobs: noise scale(0.5)/noise amount(0.1), Resolution(256 default), radius -> profile roundness/waviness
  nodegroup_star_cross_section / cylax / coconut: alternate profiles (rot symmetry N=5/N/3, float_curve control points) -> lobed silhouettes if swapped in.

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/fruit_utils.py
  Shared geonode helpers used across the pipeline:
    nodegroup_shape_quadratic(radius_control_points) -> extrudes profile along a bezier into the body; controls tilt/pos noise and radius curve.
    nodegroup_random_rotation_scale (rot mean/std, scale mean/std) -> per-instance cell randomization.
    nodegroup_point_on_mesh (Distance Min, Density Max=10000, noise) -> where cells scatter.
    nodegroup_instance_on_points, nodegroup_surface_bump (Displacement/Scale), nodegroup_add_dent, nodegroup_add_crater, nodegroup_attach_to_nearest, nodegroup_align_top_to_horizon, nodegroup_hair, nodegroup_rot_semmetry, nodegroup_scale_mesh, nodegroup_mix_vector, nodegroup_manhattan -> reusable displacement/placement/geometry math.

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/general_fruit.py
  FruitFactoryGeneralFruit: base class; assembles cross_section→shape→surface→stem, joins, aligns, converts to mesh, applies random size.
    knobs: obj.scale *= normal(1,0.1) (random size jitter) * scale * scale_multiplier -> per-instance size; crosssectionlib/shapelib/surfacelib/stemlib dicts -> which module variants are selectable
  general_fruit_geometry_nodes: wires the four param dicts into one geonode tree (edit routing/order here).

FILE: assets/objects/fruits/__init__.py
  Registers fruit factories (exports FruitFactoryPineapple etc.); add new factory names here.

LINKED TO INFINIGEN (infra — do NOT edit, resolved from the original package):
  assets/__init__.py -> asset package init
  core/__init__.py -> core package init
  core/nodes/node_wrangler.py -> NodeWrangler / Nodes API for building geometry & shader node trees
  core/placement/factory.py -> AssetFactory base class (seeding, asset spawning interface)
  core/surface.py -> add_geomod / shaderfunc_to_material: attach geonode & shader functions to objects
  core/tagging.py -> tag_object semantic labeling
  core/util/__init__.py -> util package init
  core/util/blender.py -> apply_transform, purge_empty_materials, object helpers
  core/util/color.py -> hsv2rgba color conversion used for all sampled colors
  core/util/math.py -> FixedSeed deterministic RNG context
